summary: Repaired the pure reservation replay module with monotonic receipt time, pre-command expiry, transport outcome replay and conflict detection, immutable reservation terms, cancellation tombstones, terminal-state protection, and hold-safe stock adjustments.
tests_run: Ran functions.tests against public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs: 11 tests passed, 0 failed (exit code 0).
limitations: Assumes well-formed inputs as specified; does not add input validation or numeric overflow handling beyond JavaScript Number arithmetic.
Expiry scans stored reservations on each receipt; no large-scale performance benchmark was run.
Validation is limited to the supplied public tests and the added candidate tests; no external systems were accessed.
